message: Delinquency sweep, started by hand. Read the loans in core_banking that are 30 or more days past due with status 'delinquent', with the customer's name and email. For each loan: email the customer a payment reminder (the subject names the loan id) and write an audit row in ops_db (entity 'loan', entity_id the loan id, action 'reminder_sent', detail the days past due). A loan with more than 15000 outstanding also needs a collections officer to approve escalating it (one task per loan, assigned to collections@bank.test, 2 days to decide): approved -> audit action 'escalated' and email collections@bank.test naming the loan; rejected or no answer -> nothing more.

spec.title: Delinquency sweep
spec.summary: A manual sweep reads delinquent loans (30+ days past due) with customer details, emails each customer a reminder and logs it in ops_db. For loans over 15000 outstanding, it asks collections@bank.test to approve escalation within 2 days. On approval it logs 'escalated' and emails collections. On rejection or no answer, nothing more happens.

parameters.query: SELECT l.loan_id, l.outstanding, l.days_past_due, c.full_name, c.email FROM loans l JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.days_past_due >= 30 AND l.status = 'delinquent'
